query_ground_truth.rationale: Persistent storage of the downloaded invoice attachments requires an integration capable of receiving and saving remote files to cloud storage.

results.use_case: upload files from url to google drive
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if uploading local bytes)] [Prerequisite]: Stage each file in COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH to obtain a plain-string s3key for upload.

[Optional (if destination folder id is unknown or duplicates are possible)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve the folder using GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE (folders-only, trashed=false, scope by parent when possible); if missing, create it via GOOGLEDRIVE_CREATE_FOLDER and store the returned id.

[Required (choose one source per file)] [Step]: Upload using GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FILE (staged s3key) or GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FROM_URL (server-reachable source); pass the destination folder id when needed and capture the uploaded file id (may appear under data.id or as a top-level field).

[Optional (if you must replace instead of creating duplicates)] [Step]: Identify the existing item with GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE, then update-in-place using GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_UPDATE_FILE (keep the same file id across reruns).
[Optional (for verification or returning a link)] [Next Step]: Confirm key fields using GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA (request only needed fields such as id, parents, and webViewLink).

[Optional (if the item must be organized under a different parent)] [Step]: Re-parent using GOOGLEDRIVE_MOVE_FILE (include remove_parents for a true move; otherwise it can remain in multiple folders).
[Fallback (if upload is large/flaky or repeatedly fails)] [Fallback]: Retry via GOOGLEDRIVE_RESUMABLE_UPLOAD and resume only failed parts; restart if the session expires.
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE] Can return HTTP 200 with an empty files list; name-only matches are ambiguous unless filtered to folder mimeType, trashed=false, and scoped by parent.
[GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FILE] Fails validation if file_to_upload.s3key is missing or not a plain string; HTTP 403 with insufficient authentication scopes requires fixing authorization before retries.

[GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FROM_URL] Requires the exact source_url field; server-side fetch can fail with 401/403 for protected sources or 404 when the remote object is missing, and omitting parent uploads to root.
[GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA] Schema is strict (e.g., expects fileId) and fields must be explicitly requested to get link/parent data.
[GOOGLEDRIVE_MOVE_FILE] add_parents/remove_parents must be strings (remove_parents may be comma-separated); omitting remove_parents leaves the item in multiple folders.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Parallel stage+upload pattern for many files with per-item result capture.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import concurrent.futures

def up_one(item,parent_id):
    r=stage_bytes(item["content"])
    s3key=(r[0]["s3key"] if isinstance(r,tuple) else r["s3key"])
    resp,_=run_composio_tool("GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FILE",{"file_to_upload":{"name":item["name"],"mimetype":item["mimetype"],"s3key":s3key},"folder_to_upload_to":parent_id})
    d=(resp.get("data") or {})
    return {"id":d.get("id") or resp.get("id"),"link":d.get("webViewLink") or resp.get("webViewLink"),"error":resp.get("error")}

items=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as ex:
    results=list(ex.map(lambda it: up_one(it,parent_id), items))
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Google Drive is a cloud storage solution for uploading, sharing, and collaborating on files across devices, with robust search and offline access. Special usecases: Sharing google sheets/docs or any G-Suite files with specific emails.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=googledrive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="googledrive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any googledrive tools.

GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FILE.description: Uploads a file (max 5MB) to Google Drive, placing it in the specified folder or root if no valid folder ID is provided. Always creates a new file (never updates existing); use GOOGLEDRIVE_EDIT_FILE to update with a stable file_id. Uploaded files are private by default; configure sharing via GOOGLEDRIVE_ADD_FILE_SHARING_PREFERENCE.

name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

file_to_upload.description: File to upload to Google Drive (max 5MB). Use a clear filename and accurate MIME type, for example `application/pdf`; incorrect values can cause Drive to convert or misrender the file.

folder_to_upload_to.description: Optional ID of the target Google Drive folder; can be obtained using 'Find Folder' or similar actions. Invalid or missing IDs silently fall back to Drive root with no error — resolve the correct folder ID first using GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE.

GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FROM_URL.description: Tool to fetch a file from a provided URL server-side and upload it into Google Drive. Use when you need to reliably persist externally hosted files into Drive without client-side downloads or temporary storage.

name.description: Name for the file in Google Drive, including extension (e.g., 'report.pdf', 'image.png').

mime_type.description: Target MIME type for the file in Google Drive. If not specified, Drive auto-detects from content. Google Workspace MIME types (application/vnd.google-apps.*) trigger automatic conversion from compatible source formats: google-apps.document converts Word/ODT/HTML/RTF/TXT/PDF/images (OCR); google-apps.spreadsheet converts Excel/ODS/CSV/TSV; google-apps.presentation converts PowerPoint/ODP. Conversion requires the source content to be in a compatible format. Incompatible formats will cause upload errors.

source_url.description: HTTPS URL of the file to download and upload to Google Drive. Must be publicly accessible or include necessary authentication in source_headers.

verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates when downloading from HTTPS URLs. Set to false to bypass SSL verification for URLs with certificate issues (expired certificates, hostname mismatches, self-signed certificates). Only disable for trusted sources.

source_headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to include when downloading from source_url. Use for authentication tokens, signed URLs, or CDN-specific headers.

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the parent folder in Google Drive. If not specified, the file will be uploaded to the root of My Drive.

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the request supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true for broader compatibility.

GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA.description: Tool to get a file's metadata by ID. Use to verify `mimeType`, `parents`, and `trashed` status before destructive operations (delete/move/export), or to confirm `mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.document'` before calling GOOGLEDOCS_* tools (non-native files require GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE). Only returns metadata visible to the connected account; public access requires GOOGLEDRIVE_ADD_FILE_SHARING_PREFERENCE. High-frequency calls risk `403 rateLimitExceeded`; apply exponential backoff.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use this for partial responses to request only specific metadata fields. Common fields: id, name, mimeType, webViewLink, webContentLink, createdTime, modifiedTime, size, quotaBytesUsed, parents, owners, permissions. Use '*' to return all available fields. Note: The deprecated v2 field 'alternateLink' is automatically migrated to 'webViewLink'. Example: 'id,name,mimeType,webViewLink,createdTime,modifiedTime'. Most fields (webViewLink, parents, owners, size, modifiedTime, etc.) are omitted by default — explicitly list required fields or use '*' (increases latency). `md5Checksum` is null for native Google Workspace files (Docs/Sheets/Slides); use `mimeType` to classify items — folders use `mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder'` and Workspace files return `size=null`. `modifiedTime` is RFC 3339 UTC format.

fileId.description: The Google Drive file ID (an opaque alphanumeric string like '1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j'), NOT a file name. If you only have a file name, use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE or GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILES to get the file ID first.

includeLabels.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

supportsAllDrives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true to ensure files in shared drives are accessible.

includePermissionsForView.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response. Only 'published' is supported.
